article.title: InMobi推出Accelerate，以七個AI代理協作處理廣告活動
article.summary: InMobi推出自助廣告平台Accelerate，讓中小企業及代理商在同一介面規劃、建立和衡量跨平台廣告。
highlights: 七個AI代理分工處理業務分析、受眾策略、媒體規劃、文案、設計、推出及優化。
活動計劃、素材及預算須先經批准，持續優化可由廣告主設定授權範圍。
article.why: 代理商可評估是否能把重複的建案工序交給工具，並保留客戶對預算和素材的審批。
article.next_step: 以一個低預算活動檢查平台連接、素材規格及審批記錄，再決定授權哪些調整。
article.detail: InMobi表示，Accelerate可由企業網站和活動目標開始，整理受眾、媒體計劃、素材與預算。公司列出的推出時可連接平台包括Google Ads、Meta、Microsoft Advertising、TikTok及ChatGPT Ads。團隊試用時可先核對帳戶資格和各渠道的實際權限，並把所有預算變動納入同一份審批記錄。
article.title_en: InMobi launches Accelerate with seven agents for campaign work
article.summary_en: InMobi launched self-service ad platform Accelerate for small businesses and agencies to plan, build and measure campaigns across platforms.
highlights_en: Seven AI agents cover business analysis, audience strategy, media planning, copy, design, launch and optimization.
Plans, assets and budgets require approval. Advertisers can authorize ongoing optimization within limits.
article.why_en: Agencies can assess repetitive campaign setup tasks while retaining client review of budgets and creative.
article.next_step_en: Use one small-budget campaign to check platform connections, asset specifications and approval records before authorizing changes.
article.detail_en: InMobi says Accelerate starts with a website and campaign goal to assemble audiences, a media plan, assets and budgets. The launch lists Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok and ChatGPT Ads among its connections. Teams can verify their account eligibility and channel permissions and record every budget change in one approval log.
